scripts.test: GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null node --test 'test/**/*.test.ts' && GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null bun test ./test/
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --noEmit false --declaration --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --outDir dist --rootDir . && cp src/sandbox/engine.cjs dist/src/sandbox/ && mkdir -p dist/native/build && cp native/sandbox.c dist/native/ && (cp native/build/ask.* dist/native/build/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.bundle:quickjs: bun build .github/release/quickjs.ts --target=node --format=cjs --minify --banner '// Generated by npm run bundle:quickjs. QuickJS and quickjs-emscripten: see LICENSE.' --outfile=src/sandbox/engine.cjs
